shadows.name: member-card

motion.name: member-card
motion.purpose: Straightens the member card during name entry.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Navy action for form submissions and hero links.

components.name: Text field
components.description: White field with a keyword label and shared focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field-label{font-family:var(--font-geist-sans,Geist),system-ui,sans-serif;display:grid;gap:.375rem;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--color-text,#0F1E40)}.ds-field{font-family:var(--font-geist-sans,Geist),system-ui,sans-serif;min-height:2.75rem;box-sizing:border-box;padding:.625rem .75rem;background:white;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#0F1E40) 19%,transparent);border-radius:var(--radius,10px);color:var(--color-text,#0F1E40);font-weight:400}.ds-field:focus{border-color:var(--color-primary,#1A3D8A)}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-accent,#C8880A) 64%,white);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Directory search
components.description: The search entry point above categories and results.
components.html: <form class="ds-search" role="search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4 4"/></svg><input type="search" aria-label="Buscar profissionais" placeholder="Serviço, nome ou cidade"><button type="submit">Buscar</button></form>
components.css: .ds-search{font-family:var(--font-geist-sans,Geist),system-ui,sans-serif;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:.625rem;padding:.375rem;background:white;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#0F1E40) 19%,transparent);border-radius:var(--radius,10px)}.ds-search svg{width:1.25rem;margin-left:.375rem}.ds-search input{font-family:var(--font-geist-sans,Geist),system-ui,sans-serif;min-height:2.75rem;width:100%;border:0;color:var(--color-text,#0F1E40)}.ds-search button{font-family:var(--font-geist-sans,Geist),system-ui,sans-serif;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-primary,#1A3D8A) 73%,black);color:white;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius,10px);min-height:2.75rem;padding:.625rem 1rem;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:650;}.ds-search button:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-primary,#1A3D8A) 57%,black)}.ds-search :focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-accent,#C8880A) 64%,white);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Category index
components.description: Category navigation uses an underlined active link.
components.html: Todas as categoriasServiços
components.css: .ds-categories{font-family:var(--font-geist-sans,Geist),system-ui,sans-serif;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.375rem}.ds-categories a{display:block;padding:.625rem .75rem;color:var(--color-text,#0F1E40);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#0F1E40) 19%,transparent);border-radius:var(--radius,10px);font-size:.875rem;text-decoration:none}.ds-categories a:hover,.ds-categories a[aria-current]{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-surface,#F8F6EF) 54%,white)}.ds-categories a[aria-current]{font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.25em}.ds-categories a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-accent,#C8880A) 64%,white);outline-offset:3px;}@media(min-width:48rem){.ds-categories{display:grid;gap:0;border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#0F1E40) 19%,transparent)}.ds-categories a{border:0;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#0F1E40) 19%,transparent);border-radius:0;padding-inline:.25rem}}

components.name: Listing preview
components.description: A ruled result with an editorial title and optional media.
components.css: .ds-listing{font-family:var(--font-geist-sans,Geist),system-ui,sans-serif;display:block;border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#0F1E40) 19%,transparent);padding-top:.75rem;color:var(--color-text,#0F1E40);text-decoration:none}.ds-listing h3{margin:.5rem 0;font:400 1.625rem/1.12 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}.ds-listing:hover h3{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.18em}.ds-listing p{margin:.5rem 0;font-size:.875rem;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#0F1E40) 62%,white)}.ds-listing:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-accent,#C8880A) 64%,white);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Admin navigation
components.description: Private navigation with the workspace's fixed slate palette.

narrative.overview: Warm paper, Georgia headlines and thin rules organize the directory. Search leads into a category index, and profiles place contact methods near the top. The slate admin workspace accompanies runtime public theming.
dos: Do use the configured public colors and radius.
Do keep search above the index and place contacts early in profile reading order.
Do show ratings when enabled and data is available.
Do scope public theme experiments to the settings preview.
